claims.text: An UPDATE or DELETE does not remove the old row version immediately, because other transactions may still see it; once no transaction needs it, VACUUM reclaims its space for new rows.

claims.text: The docs give VACUUM four jobs: recover or reuse space taken by updated or deleted rows, update planner statistics, update the visibility map, and protect against transaction ID and multixact ID wraparound.
